basics.name: Megnath Ramesh
basics.label: Postdoctoral Fellow & Robotics Researcher
basics.summary: Postdoctoral Fellow at University of Waterloo developing generative AI models for robot path planning in coverage and exploration tasks. Ph.D. in Electrical and Computer Engineering with expertise in combinatorial optimization, algorithm design, and robot planning under uncertainty.

work.name: University of Waterloo
work.summary: Developing generative AI models to plan robot paths for long-horizon coverage and exploration tasks.
highlights: Advisors: Stephen L. Smith and Baris Fidan

work.name: University of Waterloo & Avidbots Corp.
work.summary: Developed efficient coverage planning algorithms for industrial cleaning robots with real-world testing and implementation.
highlights: Developed efficient coverage planning algorithms for industrial cleaning robots
Tested algorithms using real-world robots encountering environmental uncertainties
Collaborated with Avidbots engineering team on algorithm implementation and testing
Mentored junior researchers in robotics problem-solving

work.name: University of Waterloo
work.summary: Teaching assistant for algorithm design, digital control, and analog control systems courses.

work.name: ScopeAR
work.summary: Developed features and fixed defects in a cross-platform augmented reality (AR) video calling application.

work.name: VEERUM
work.summary: Developed a pilot project using autonomous robots for generating digital twins of construction facilities.
